summary.en: Build a menu-driven library with borrowing rules, ordered collections and validated file storage.
summary.bn: মেনু দিয়ে বই যোগ, ধার আর ফেরত দেওয়ার অ্যাপ বানাও এবং ফাইলে ডেটা রাখো।

notes: All programs use Java 17 APIs and language rules.

sections.title: Build a small library with explicit state transitions
Name the model, capability and storage boundary
Run the menu with line-oriented input
Save a complete snapshot and validate a complete load
Follow a borrow, save and restore session
Complete application and a failed-load demonstration
Check invariants before extending the menu

examples.title: Complete menu-driven library
examples.explanationHtml: The menu coordinates a plain Library model and a TextStore. Save and Load are explicit; sorted ids make displays predictable.

examples.title: Reject duplicate stored ids without changing the library
examples.explanationHtml: The file repeats id 9. Loading fails before replacement, so the existing id 3 stays available. The display uses a LibraryItem reference to dispatch status.

practice.title: Complete the library commands
practice.statementHtml: Implement the menu described in the lesson. Read line-oriented commands 0..6. Add reads id then title; Borrow and Return read id. Use the exact prompts and messages from the complete example. The isolated session starts without library.tsv. Persist only on Save; failed Load preserves current state.
hints: Parse all stored rows before committing the loaded map.

practice.title: Extend with a reference-only item
practice.statementHtml: Add a ReferenceItem concept that is listed but cannot be borrowed. Describe class and interface changes without weakening the existing capability contract.
practice.answerHtml: ReferenceItem extends LibraryItem and implements status for display, but does not implement Loanable. Widen the inventory to LibraryItem and make the controller check for Loanable before borrowing. Extend the file format with an explicit item-kind field and validate it during loading.
hints: A shared base does not require every item to have every capability.

practice.title: Plan a damaged-file check
practice.statementHtml: The live library contains ids 3 and 7. A load file contains valid id 9 followed by another id 9. State the required outcome and explain the control flow.
practice.answerHtml: TextStore rejects the duplicate before returning its candidate list. Main catches IOException and prints LOAD FAILED. Library.replace is never called, so ids 3 and 7 remain and id 9 is not partially installed.
hints: Look for the commit point after validation.

quiz.prompt: Which borrow and return transitions succeed for a new book?
quiz.explanation: Only the first borrow succeeds before a return makes the book available again.

quiz.prompt: Why does Book implement Loanable rather than making every LibraryItem borrowable?
options: It removes the need for methods
Borrowing is a capability some item types may lack
quiz.explanation: A narrow capability avoids forcing unsupported operations onto all item types.

quiz.prompt: Why use TreeMap for the inventory?
options: It provides unique id lookup with sorted id traversal
quiz.explanation: The map expresses lookup and deterministic id order.

quiz.prompt: What happens after a duplicate add?
When should a load replace the live inventory?
quiz.explanation: A temporary candidate preserves the old model on failure.

options: Tabs separate fields in the file format
quiz.explanation: The simple format has no escaping protocol for embedded delimiters.

quiz.prompt: Does copying the snapshot list clone its Book objects?
quiz.explanation: A structural list copy preserves references to the same mutable books.

quiz.prompt: When does the application save automatically?
quiz.explanation: Explicit persistence makes success and failure visible.

quiz.prompt: What does a missing storage file mean for Load?
options: Automatic creation of a borrowed book
LOAD FAILED with current data retained
quiz.explanation: A missing input is a storage failure rather than a valid empty snapshot.

keyPoints.en: Model methods guard loan state transitions.
keyPoints.bn: মডেলের মেথড বই ধার আর ফেরতের নিয়ম ঠিক রাখে।

keyPoints.en: Interfaces express capabilities independently of shared fields.
keyPoints.bn: ইন্টারফেসে কী কাজ করা যায় তা বলা হয়, শুধু ফিল্ড ভাগ করা নয়।
TreeMap-এ বইয়ের আইডি অনুযায়ী তালিকা সাজানো থাকে।

keyPoints.en: Loading commits only after all records validate.
keyPoints.bn: সব রেকর্ড ঠিক থাকলেই ফাইলের ডেটা বসে।

keyPoints.en: Save and load failures must remain visible.
keyPoints.bn: ফাইলে ডেটা লেখা বা পড়া ব্যর্থ হলে ব্যবহারকারীকে জানাও।

examQuestions.question: Draw and explain the project class relationships.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Book extends LibraryItem and implements Loanable. Library contains a map of Book references keyed by id. TextStore converts snapshots to and from UTF-8 rows. Main coordinates menu actions without owning the storage format.

examQuestions.question: Explain why loading into live storage row by row is unsafe.
examQuestions.answerHtml: A later invalid row would leave a partly replaced inventory. A temporary collection allows full validation before one replacement, preserving the previous model after failure.

examQuestions.question: Propose the next requirements for multi-user lending.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Define transaction boundaries for borrow checks and updates, persistent consistency across users, identity and permissions, and conflict feedback. A synchronized local method alone cannot coordinate several separate processes sharing a file.
